class.name: JRPGItemData
class.brief_description: An item the party carries and uses.
class.description: Database entry for an item, with the usable fields of [JRPGUsableData] plus its item type, price and whether using it consumes it.

method.name: is_hidden
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for hidden items, which never appear on the item screen and are only offered when an event asks the player to pick an item.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], using the item uses one up.
Where the item appears: with regular items, in the key items section, or hidden.
Shop price. The item sells for half of it; a price of 0 means it cannot be sold.

constants.constant: A key item, listed in its own section of the item screen.
A hidden item of the first group.
A hidden item of the second group.
